name: Judge 2: site rules and evidence honesty, re-judged on the website architecture
judge: Research only. Nothing ships. No other repo file changed. Scores designs A, B, C and D on the site-rules and evidence-honesty lens only.
architecture_basis: main-architecture.json (main_head 349df2a; this branch includes main at 195d68c). The product is the website: static pages written by website/build.py, rebuilt from empty every 10 minutes by .github/workflows/website.yml (cron line 15; build job timeout 15 min, line 38; deploy job timeout 10 min, line 165) and published by GitHub Pages. The desktop app is parked (DECISIONS.md:314-323; AGENTS.md:13-14). Designs A and B target the parked app and are scored only on what transfers.
lens: AGENTS.md rules 4-9 as on disk. Rule 4 (AGENTS.md:66-72): Python builds all data and pages; hand-written JavaScript only for browser-only needs, documented inline; no framework; third-party code and fonts served by the site, not a CDN. Rule 5 (73-76): evidence kinds kept apart; missing inputs show Data unavailable; demo data labelled DEMO everywhere. Rule 6 (77-79): alerts. Rule 7 (80-84): CONTRACTS. Rule 8: real browser. Rule 9: no best claims. Also: browser fetches only site files (test_site.py:459-471; regex at line 464); freshness per sources.py; gap words and 'This is not an all-clear.' (map.html:52-59); the disclaimer (DESIGN.md:167-168); the text List (DESIGN.md:170-173); SAMPLE labelling (base.html:16-18; gridded.py:100-109; build.py:270); no severity colour ramps; legends with words (AGENTS.md:91-93).
scale: 0-2: cannot be built on the site as designed (content may transfer). 3-4: needs an owner reversal before any build. 5-6: buildable after owner rulings on site rules. 7-8: buildable with specified fixes; owner input limited to data and labelling. 9-10: fits as written.
method: Read main-architecture.json first; README sections 1-7; the supervisor log ARCHITECTURE SHIFT section; the four designs in full; judge-rules.json (the earlier desktop-lens judge, re-scored here, not copied). AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md from disk. DECISIONS.md D27-D29 at lines 314-330, 338-350, 372-400 and 452-470. website/build.py, gridded.py, sources.py; templates/base.html, about.html, map.html; static/map/map.js (lines 1-12, 33-39, 2093); tests/test_site.py (455-475); website.yml (grep); website/sample.py (existence and labels); grep of rights-matrix.json and hosting-options.json. judge-engineering.json was not read; judge-product.json does not exist. Design line citations were spot-checked against the repo, not all re-verified.

scores.name: Design D: the globe as a fifth static page of the website, vendored three.js, site-files-only by default
reasons: Fits the site architecture: a fifth static page written by build.py from the same 10-minute run (main-architecture.json website_pipeline; build.py:375-379 rebuilds _site from empty). No server and no second job (AGENTS.md:7-12).

Vendored third-party code, not a CDN (AGENTS.md:71-72). Re-checked 2026-10-17: three.module.js 662,772 B and three.core.js 1,458,113 B (unpkg) equal the design's figures; the LICENSE is MIT (copyright 2010-2026 three.js authors).

Default keeps the browser on site files only (D-G1 default). Streamed tiles are a named owner option. The existing test at test_site.py:464 checks HTML tags only, so the design needs its own runtime request check (smoke_globe.py).

Honesty content is the most complete of the four: a Python-written text List for every value (DESIGN.md:170-173); loaded, problem and stale states with the page-age banner (DESIGN.md:153-162); 'No radar data', 'No model data' and 'Outside map area' (map.js:33-39); 'This is not an all-clear.' (map.html:52-59); the disclaimer verbatim (DESIGN.md:167-168); parallax wording verbatim from parallax.json; below-ground cells not drawn and counted; no MESH value; no interpolation across frames or levels.

Stated JavaScript budget: loader at most 600 lines and 40,000 B; volume.js at most 250 lines and 15,000 B. Of 15 duties, 13 are browser-only under rule 4; duty 9 is the page-age check, which rule 4 accepts; duty 10 is not (fatal flaw 1).
fatal_flaws: Duty 10 (stale and problem classes from valid times against the viewer's clock) is outside the browser work rule 4 accepts (AGENTS.md:66-72 names the page-age check, playback, scrubbing, menus, sheets and geolocation). Decision OD-2: owner rules on a second documented clock use, or the classes move to Python-written words, leaving only the page-age check in JavaScript (recommended).

Sample labelling: rule 5 says demo data is 'labelled DEMO everywhere' (AGENTS.md:73-76), but the site labels invented builds SAMPLE (base.html:16-18; gridded.py:108-109; build.py:270). globe.html is its own document with no base.html banner (design-d s1). Decision OD-1: owner picks one label and amends rule 5 or renames the site's strings.

MRMS gaps are defined two ways. The flat map treats every negative MRMS value as no radar coverage and hatches it 'No radar coverage' (gridded.py:191-198 and 338-360; map.js:33-35). The design treats -99 and -999 as 'No radar data' and negative valid dBZ as real echo. Decision OD-3: one MRMS gap rule and its words for both maps, pending the NSSL table check (mrms.json).
Streamed imagery tiles (D-G1, not the default) would break the site-files-only test (test_site.py:459-471). Decision OD-7: owner ruling on D-G1 and a changed test.

Earth texture (NASA Blue Marble): NASA's imagery terms conflict on the page (re-checked; see facts_rechecked), and no Blue Marble sponsor term was found. Decision OD-5: owner or counsel. The default (basemap only, no texture) avoids the question.
Publication through Actions (gh-terms-2 and gh-terms-3, hosting-options.json) applies to the whole site, not to this design. Decision OD-6: counsel reading, once for the site.
defects: Hand-built products (Earth texture, basemap raster and terrain field, each 'built once by hand') need committed Python builders under tools/ with byte-identical reruns, as tools/build_basemap.py does (AGENTS.md:31; DECISIONS D28 'identical bytes on a rerun'). A hand-made file is not provenance under rule 4.

New static files (three.js, globe.js, Earth texture, basemap raster, terrain PNG, volume.js) are not in VERSIONED (build.py:361-370), so unchanged files change address on every build. The content-hash test (test_site.py:473-486) does not cover them.

No check for JavaScript-initiated requests: test_site.py:464 inspects only script, link and img tags. The smoke test must record every request and fail on any host outside the preview site (tools/smoke_map.py pattern). A static scan of globe.js and globe.css must find no absolute URL.
'No interpolation' must cover GPU sampling. State nearest-neighbour filtering for MRMS class rasters and cloud PNGs, and do not reuse the flat map's sigma 1 px smoothing (gridded.py:91-92).
No loud-failure test that every globe layer key exists in sources.CONTRACTS with a freshness limit (AGENTS.md:80-84).
Alert cases: no can't-tell case for unknown codes, no zone-matched-without-outline case, and no 'Alerts not checked' per town (DESIGN.md:158). Parity is not tied to sources.py matching.
Legend: each echo, cloud and terrain colour class needs its word (AGENTS.md:91-93). Times in the List should be Montana time with UTC stored (AGENTS.md:94-95; map.js:127-157).
Accessibility and print: print hides the globe; the List sits beside the canvas; canvas title; one h1; skip link (DESIGN.md:170-173; base.html:15 pattern).

Weight: first visit 2.8 MB computed (about 14 s at an assumed 1.6 Mbit/s). DESIGN.md:29-30 names slow connections without a number. Decision OD-9 sets the budget (3.0 MB pass, 4.0 MB stop, design-d s7).
Pages reads: a 12-frame loop is about 10 MB per build, about 43 GB per month (computed). The 60-frame loop is about 217 GB per month, above the 100 GB soft limit (gh-pages-2). Keep the phase 4 cap.

scores.name: Design C: Python-first overlays on the vendored Leaflet map (C2 first; C1 globe gated)
reasons: Closest to the cheapest rule path: Leaflet 1.9.4 is already vendored and served by the site (leaflet.js 147,552 B, re-measured; AGENTS.md:71-72; map.js:7). No new library. Python builds PNG overlays and SVG transects in the existing 15-minute job. New duties N1-N6 are DOM or browser-only.

Evidence kinds apart: the echo raster reuses radar_estimate with the label 'modified; not NOAA's unaltered product'. Satellite kinds wait for DECISIONS entries (AGENTS.md:73-76). Cloud height is labelled an estimate, never measured.
Freshness tied to sources.py: MRMS 1800 s matches sources.py:115 (30 min) and gridded.py:53-54. Constants go in CONTRACTS with a loud-failure test (rule 7).
Runtime check P1 requires zero requests to other hosts and a 288, 390 and 1440 px smoke run (smoke_map.py; rule 8).
Parallax legend verbatim from parallax.json; 'Not corrected for cloud-top height'; cloud base stated as not observed.
fatal_flaws: Satellite kinds satellite_image and satellite_estimate, and their freshness limits, need DECISIONS entries before any cloud or Band 13 layer ships (AGENTS.md:73-76; main-architecture.json item 14). Decision OD-4: owner approves the two kinds and their labels.

N5, a per-minute age clock in JavaScript, is time arithmetic that rule 4 does not list (AGENTS.md:66-72). Decision OD-2: owner ruling, or replace with Python-written as-of text plus the page-age check (recommended).
Publishing NOAA-derived pictures from Actions to Pages depends on the Actions terms (gh-terms-1 and gh-terms-3). Decision OD-6: counsel reading. Design C's P0 stop already gates it.
defects: Echo legend 'Blank = no echo at 35 dBZ or more, which is not an all-clear' is false for a column whose only 35 dBZ-or-more levels lie below ground, because the mask removes them before the top is taken. Count below-ground-only columns separately and never write 'no echo' for them (DESIGN.md:275-276; rule 5).

States row: 'echo tops not drawn; Terrain unavailable: heights shown above sea level only' contradicts the design's own rule 'No terrain grid means the echo layer is Unavailable'. Use Unavailable with the reason.
The legend does not say the top is the highest of 11 sampled levels. Say 'highest of 11 sampled heights'.
No text List for the new layers (DESIGN.md:170-173: maps keep their facts in lists beside them).
No disclaimer on the map page. map.html does not extend base.html (main-architecture.json), and the disclaimer is required (main-architecture.json item 15; DESIGN.md:167-168).

Null geometry: no can't-tell case for unknown codes; three parity fixtures rather than 20. The 240 alert scenarios do not run in the website workflow (website.yml:84), so parity must be tested in the site's test file (AGENTS.md:77-79).

No SAMPLE rule: 'Sample pictures are invented' (risk 13). Sample layers need the SAMPLE banner and SAMPLE-style legend notes (base.html:16-18; gridded.py:100-109), and a test that no sample frame reaches a live build.
Gap words: 'No radar data' for -99 and -999 is not reconciled with 'No radar coverage' on the flat map (gridded.py:191-198; map.js:33-35).

Citation errors: base.html:167-168 (base.html has 64 lines; the page-age script is about lines 46-62). build.py:481-487 'experimental' flag (no such flag; those lines are the argparse block). 'ROADMAP Next 8 host decision' (no host item).

scores.name: Design B: separate globe window served by the parked desktop shell, library bundled
reasons: Rule 4 fit is strong where it counts: a bundled library pinned by sha384 with its licence (library_pin_and_integrity), no CDN at runtime, 13 documented duties, an explicit not-in-JavaScript list, and G-JS5 (a failed refresh shows the last text with 'could not refresh' and never an all-clear). These transfer.

Its data path is a live server (/globe/api/state, /globe/api/alerts) and a read-only SQLite snapshot. The site has no server and no database (main-architecture.json constraints; AGENTS.md:31). The browser may fetch only site files (test_site.py:459-471; map.js:9).

Product direction: a second desktop surface for a parked app (DECISIONS.md:314-323; AGENTS.md:13-14). Its installers and manual downloads do not follow the site's publish-on-merge rule (AGENTS.md:56-57).
Honesty: 'Below ground: not drawn; not clear', the hatch 'No radar data', no severity opacity, and a '3D view could not load' banner kept apart from data states.
Gaps: no disclaimer; no SAMPLE banner (its demo rule refuses the app's demo event); freshness limits in the app's FRESH_SECONDS (weather.py:205) rather than sources.py CONTRACTS.
fatal_flaws: Blocked by product direction: O1, a DECISIONS entry reversing D27, is required before any desktop work (DECISIONS.md:314-323; AGENTS.md:13-14). Decision OD-10.
A second release channel (installers, one per OS per globe change, O4) cannot meet the site's publish-on-merge rule (AGENTS.md:56-57). Decision O4 (accept it, or drop this design).
defects: G-JS9 shows picked-feature text on hover or tap: hover-only information for a pointer user, which DESIGN.md:277-278 forbids. Add a List alternative.
G-JS4 requests /globe/api/state at an interval; a static site has no API. The fetch becomes data/globe.json (test_site.py:459-471).
Freshness limits belong in sources.py CONTRACTS with the site's values: radar 30 min (sources.py:115), stations 75 min (sources.py:34), page 25 min (base.html).
No disclaimer and no SAMPLE banner. Add both (DESIGN.md:167-168; base.html:16-18).
Keep the sha384 lock file and the licence bundle; they are the strongest pinning in the set and transfer to the site's Leaflet and fonts.

scores.name: Design A: Jinja-generated CesiumJS page inside the parked Flask app, library from a CDN
reasons: Cesium 1.146.0 loads from a CDN with sha384 integrity (design-a library_pin_and_integrity_policy). AGENTS.md:71-72 says third-party code is served by the site, not a CDN, and the design's host would fail the site's host test (test_site.py:464). The hashes are good; the host breaks rule 4.

Built for the parked Flask app: /globe, /api/globe/* routes, a POST settings route, a session-cookie gate, a CSP header and a Host check (design-a data_endpoints; route_security_tests). A static Pages site runs no server code (main-architecture.json: no database; the build writes data/map.json and data/state.json), so these have no site equivalent.

Honesty content transfers well: null-geometry cases A-F; 'no radar data' for -99 and -999, with 'no radar coverage' withheld until verified; negative valid dBZ as real values below threshold; below-ground cells not drawn and counted; no interpolation; a parity test on 20 fixtures.

Freshness proposals conflict with sources.py: radar 15 and 60 min, MRMS 10 and 30 min, against the site's 30 min (sources.py:115) and 75 min for stations (sources.py:34). States are Live, Stale, Unavailable and Not timed, not the site's loaded, problem and stale (DESIGN.md:153-162).
No failed-refresh duty: a Live state can remain on screen after the server stops answering (judge-rules.json).
fatal_flaws: The architecture cannot run on the website: server routes, cookies and response headers have no site equivalent (main-architecture.json). Decision OD-10 (reverse D27) is the only path to this design as written, and it is a product decision.

The CDN script for Cesium violates AGENTS.md:71-72 as written. Decision: owner amends rule 4 to allow third-party hosts, or accepts vendoring Cesium (Cesium.js 6,080,574 B, Workers 1,034,391 B, Assets 4,379,545 B; globe-libs.json; phone budget O-5).
defects: States use Live, Stale, Unavailable and Not timed (design-a states) instead of loaded, problem and stale (DESIGN.md:153-162).
JS-13 compares data to decide which layers to redraw. Comparison logic in the browser is outside rule 4's list.
No text List for drawn values; no disclaimer (DESIGN.md:167-168).
The freshness table is the desktop D12 set, which judge-rules.json found conflicts with the site's values. Replace it with sources.py values and a missing-key test.
'Data unavailable' is used where the site's wording differs. The site uses it only at map.js:2093 (main-architecture.json).

ranking_note: Scores cover the site-rules and evidence-honesty lens only. They do not measure how far each design meets the owner's 3D request. No provider or library is judged on a quality claim (AGENTS.md rule 9).
grafts: For design-d, must fix: move duty 10 into Python. Python writes each source's state, valid time, age limit and a short sentence. The page-age check in base.html stays the only browser clock use (AGENTS.md:66-72). Keep duty 9.

For design-d, sample builds: add the SAMPLE banner (base.html:16-18) and SAMPLE-style legend notes (gridded.py:100-109) to globe.html, and a test that sample text and sample frames appear only in sample builds. Label follows OD-1.

From design-a, null geometry: adopt cases A-F with can't-tell wording and the reason for unknown codes (AGENTS.md:77-79); show 'Alerts not checked' per town (DESIGN.md:158); tie parity to sources.py matching on at least 20 fixtures, in the site's test file.
From design-a, malformed products: refuse a product with a value outside the grid, a sentinel used as a dBZ value, or no validity mask. Keep the last verified frame with its age.
From design-b, failed refresh: keep the last Python-written state text and show 'could not refresh' beside it. Never an all-clear (G-JS5).
From design-b, pinning: a lock file for vendored files (name, version, licence, sha256); the build fails on a mismatch. Apply the same to Leaflet and the fonts.

From design-c, runtime check: record every request in smoke_globe.py and fail on any host outside the preview site (design-c P1). Add a static scan of globe.js and globe.css for absolute URLs, since test_site.py:464 checks only HTML.
From design-c, loud failure: a unit test that every globe layer key exists in sources.CONTRACTS with a freshness limit and no silent default.
From design-c, echo wording: count below-ground-only columns separately; say 'highest of 11 sampled heights'; never write 'no echo' for masked levels.

Site cache: add three.js, globe.js, the Earth texture, the basemap raster, the terrain PNG and volume.js to VERSIONED (build.py:361-370), so unchanged files keep their hash address (test_site.py:473-486 pattern).
Provenance: commit a Python builder under tools/ for the Earth texture, basemap raster and terrain field, with byte-identical reruns, as tools/build_basemap.py does (AGENTS.md:31; DECISIONS D28).
Rendering: nearest-neighbour sampling for MRMS class rasters and cloud PNGs, stated in the legend. Do not reuse the flat map's sigma 1 px smoothing (gridded.py:91-92).
Legend words: a word beside each echo, cloud and terrain colour class (AGENTS.md:91-93). Opacity never encodes severity (already in design-d).
Accessibility and print: skip link, one h1, canvas title, the List beside the canvas, print hides the globe, reduced motion (DESIGN.md:170-173).
Times: valid and retrieved times in Montana time with UTC stored (AGENTS.md:94-95; map.js:127-157).
Keep from design-d: the disclaimer verbatim on the globe page (DESIGN.md:167-168) and the Python-written text List for every value (design-d s1).
Budget: the owner sets a first-visit byte budget before phase 1 (OD-9): 3.0 MB pass, 4.0 MB stop (design-d s7).
owner_decisions: OD-1 (new, site-wide): one label for invented data. AGENTS.md:73-76 says DEMO; the site says SAMPLE (base.html:16-18; gridded.py:100-109; build.py:270; test_site.py:465). Decide the label and amend rule 5, or rename the strings. Blocks sample handling in design-d and design-c.

OD-2 (new): may browser JavaScript compare valid times with the viewer's clock for per-source stale and problem classes (design-d duty 10; design-c N5)? Rule 4 lists only the page-age check and the map's own features (AGENTS.md:66-72). Recommended: no; Python writes the words.

OD-3 (new): one MRMS gap rule and its words across the flat map and the globe. Today the flat map hatches every negative MRMS value as no radar coverage (gridded.py:191-198; map.js:33-35); designs C and D call -99 and -999 'No radar data' and treat negative dBZ as real echo. Pending the NSSL table check (mrms.json).

OD-4 (new, DECISIONS entries): satellite_image and satellite_estimate kinds and their freshness limits (design-c P1; design-d s5). DECISIONS.md runs to D29; next free number D30, to be re-checked when written.
OD-5 (existing, O-6): NASA Blue Marble. The NASA imagery terms conflict on the page; no sponsor term found. Owner or counsel. The default is basemap only.

OD-6 (existing, O-7, site-wide): Actions terms. gh-terms-2 limits Actions to development, testing and publication of the software project; gh-terms-3 names use 'as a content delivery network' (hosting-options.json). Counsel reading, once for the site.
OD-7 (existing, D-G1): streamed imagery tiles would change test_site.py:459-471. The default stays site-files-only.
OD-8 (existing, O-5): phone floor 288 px (smoke_pages.py:23) or 320 px (DESIGN.md:29-30 and :77).
OD-9 (new): first-visit byte budget for the globe page. Design-d computes 2.8 MB, with its own 3.0 MB pass and 4.0 MB stop (s7 phase 1).
OD-10 (existing, O1): revive the desktop app by a DECISIONS entry reversing D27. Needed only for designs A and B.
